technique.summary: Use GraphQL introspection queries to discover the entire API schema, including hidden fields, mutations, and types. This reveals the full attack surface including admin-only operations, sensitive fields, and internal types.
steps: Send an introspection query to dump the full schema
Analyze types, queries, mutations, and subscriptions for sensitive operations
Look for admin mutations, internal fields, deprecated but active endpoints
Test each discovered mutation/query for authorization issues
Check for query depth/complexity limits — abuse deeply nested queries for DoS
Test batch queries to bypass rate limiting

payloads.notes: List all mutations with their arguments
Batch mutation — may bypass rate limiting

bypassTechniques: If introspection is disabled, try field suggestion probing: {use} → 'Did you mean user?'
Use GET requests with query parameter instead of POST
Check if introspection is only disabled in production but enabled in staging
